description: This file implements a digital signer class using BouncyCastle cryptography library for signing PDF documents in the PdfSharp library. It provides methods to generate digital signatures, determine signature size, and handle cryptographic algorithms.

classes.name: BouncyCastleSigner
classes.description: A class implementing IDigitalSigner using BouncyCastle for PDF signing, supporting multiple digest algorithms and certificate configurations.

methods.name: GetSignatureSizeAsync
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the generated signature asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSignatureAsync
methods.description: Generates a digital signature for the provided stream using BouncyCastle libraries.

methods.name: GetProperDigestAlgorithm
methods.description: Determines the appropriate digest algorithm based on the PDF version or digest type.

methods.name: GetAsymmetricAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate asymmetric cryptography algorithm (RSA, DSA, ECDSA) based on the certificate's OID.
